Horizon dimensions are (1,5,5,1), inclusion ranks (1,5,1), so the minimum inclusion-only terminal cover dimension is5; the minimum source-compatible cover dimension satisfies6<=M<=7. claim.summary: Over any field, a fixed normalized vector observation Lambda on V_D admits an inclusion-injective finite horizon cover with compatible paid variable actions, a marked unit and vanishing supplied source generators iff Lambda annihilates C_D. Every cover restricts to a cyclic cover. Minimum terminal dimension is min dim(V_D/I) over degree-D pseudoideals containing the source and contained in ker Lambda; it is between the horizon birth sum and dim(V_D/C_D).
claim.assessment: Elementary quotient characterization applying the recorded horizon and PC closure results. Hidden states avoid requiring ker Lambda itself to be PC-closed. No small source-dependent cover or qualifying observation is constructed. The normalized Boolean-only control attains the exponential birth bound; the degree-two path NS design admits no compatible cover of any dimension.

claim.summary: Over every field, a proper subspace J of the Boolean degree-D space, D>=2, containing all inputs of an unsatisfiable system and closed under variable multiplication of all its degree-at-most-D-1 elements, has a standard monomial of degree at least D-1. There is a (D-1)-coordinate Boolean algebra injecting linearly into the quotient, whose degree-j layer has dimension at least binom(D-1,j); total dimension is at least 2^(D-1).
claim.assessment: Working two-slack stabilization and standard-divisor proof, including inputs of degree D. Linear freeness is not a full algebra representation or a hardness conclusion.
